title: VP Health, Safety & Environmental
location: Louisville, KY
description: Job Family Group HSSE Group Job Description About us Our purpose is to bring together people, energy and markets to power and navigate a changing world. In a time of constant change and possibility we need new talent to pursue commercial opportunities, fueled by world-class insight and expertise. We’re always striving for more innovative digital solutions, sustainable outcomes and closer collaboration across our company and beyond, and you could be part of that too. Together we continue to grow as the world’s leading energy company! Role Purpose As the Vice President, Health, Safety & Environmental (HS&E) you are responsible for setting the strategic direction and providing executive leadership for HSSE performance across bp's U.S. Convenience & Mobility business. This role serves as the senior HS&E leader for a large, geographically dispersed operation encompassing company-owned retail sites, franchise locations, bakery operations, field teams, offices, and support functions across the United States. The Vice President is accountable for developing and delivering an integrated HS&E strategy that protects people, communities, assets, brand reputation, and business performance while enabling sustainable growth. The role ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements and bp standards while fostering a culture where safety, risk management, operational rigor, and environmental stewardship are embedded into every aspect of the business. Partnering closely with executive leadership, operations teams, franchise partners, and bp's central HS&E organization, the Vice President will establish enterprise-wide standards, strengthen risk management capabilities, drive continuous improvement, and ensure consistent execution of HS&E programs across a network supporting thousands of employees, contractors, customers, and business partners. This leader will provide oversight for operational risk management, process safety, occupational safety, environmental compliance, emergency preparedness and response, incident prevention, regulatory engagement, and business resilience. The role plays a critical part in enabling safe and reliable operations while supporting commercial performance, transformation initiatives, network growth, and long-term value creation. The Vice President will serve as a trusted advisor to bp’s US Convenience & Mobility leadership team, ensuring HS&E risks are identified, understood, and managed effectively while driving a culture of accountability, learning, and continuous improvement throughout the organization. Key Accountabilities Own the USCM Health, Safety & Environmental strategy and operating plan, ensuring risks across sites, fueling operations and store environments are identified, managed and mitigated. Serve as the senior advisor to the USCM leadership on health, safety, environmental, security, and operational risk matters. Lead the USCM HSSE team, setting clear priorities, performance expectations and accountability for safety and environmental outcomes across the network. Maintain a strong dotted-line relationship with bp's central HSSE function to ensure USCM continues to apply enterprise standards, tools and governance expectations. Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state and local health, safety and environmental regulations, including DOT, OSHA and EPA requirements, across USCM's store and fueling network. Partner with Operations, Construction & Maintenance and Store Support teams to embed safety and environmental considerations into site design, store operations and field execution. Lead incident investigation, root cause analysis and corrective action processes, translating lessons learned into practical improvements at store level. Provide regular reporting on safety performance, environmental compliance and emerging risks to the USCM CEO and leadership team. Skills & Experience Significant experience in health, safety, environmental or risk management leadership, ideally within convenience retail, fuel retail, grocery or another multi-site operating environment. Strong understanding of HSSE regulatory requirements applicable to retail fueling and convenience store operations, including DOT, OSHA and EPA standards. Experience leading HSSE teams and building a hands-on, field-credible safety culture across a distributed, multi-site network. Proven ability to work across matrixed reporting lines while maintaining clear accountability and independence of judgement. Strong incident investigation, risk assessment and corrective action experience. Bachelor's degree in occupational safety, environmental science, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered. Who You Will Work With You'll work with bp's central HSSE function, Operations, Construction & Maintenance, Store Support Organizations, and Legal/Compliance. This role reports to the USCM CEO, with a dotted line into bp's central HSSE function. Why join BP At BP, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly. There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others. Travel Requirement Up to 50% travel should be expected with this role Relocation Assistance: Relocation may be negotiable for this role Remote Type This position is a hybrid of office/remote working Skills Accounting for people, Accounting for people, Agility core practices, Communication, Continuous Learning, Cost-conscious decision-making, Cost Leadership, Cost Performance Management, Crisis and emergency response management, Decision Making, Driving and transport safety, Fire incident response, Hazard Id

title: EHS Officer - UAE National
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
description: A Snapshot of Your Day In this role you'll take ownership of the HSE Plan across our UAE projects, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the EQS team, project management, contractors, and Siemens Energy's clients to keep operations safe, compliant, and running smoothly. How You'll Make An Impact Develop, implement, and continuously review the site's HSE Plan, ensuring it stays aligned with project realities and evolving risks throughout the project lifecycle. Deliver monthly HSE performance reporting to both the Client and Project Management, translating site data into clear insights that support informed decision-making. Act as the on-site HSE expert, advising Project Management, engineers, and subcontractors on best practices, regulatory requirements, and risk mitigation strategies. Lead toolbox talks and regular HSE meetings with site representatives to reinforce safety awareness and keep HSE front-of-mind across the workforce. Conduct proactive site monitoring to identify unsafe practices, behaviors, and occupational health or welfare gaps before they escalate into incidents. Uphold QA procedures and statutory, regulatory, and EHS compliance across all site activities, while modeling Siemens' Business Conduct Guidelines and a collaborative, team-first working style. What You Bring A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, EHS or relevant field together with a NEBOSH International General Certificate or NEBOSH Construction Certificate, demonstrating a solid formal grounding in HSE principles. Fresh graduate or up to 3 years of practical, hands-on experience applying HSE practices within a live project or construction environment. Strong working knowledge of health, safety, and environmental requirements, along with how to translate them into effective on-site implementation. Familiarity with applicable legal and regulatory frameworks governing workplace safety, and the ability to apply them confidently in day-to-day operations. Demonstrated leadership capability, including the confidence to drive site-wide compliance and hold stakeholders accountable to HSE standards. A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset, with proven ability to participate in risk evaluation, risk reduction, and continuous HSE performance improvement. About The Team Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Opportunities to work with a global team Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

title: Vice President, Global Environmental, Health, and Safety
location: Scottsdale, AZ
description: TPI Composites, a trusted, long-term manufacturing partner to the global wind energy market, provides high-quality, cost-effective composite wind blades backed by advanced manufacturing capabilities and our proprietary, AI driven BladeAssure™ validation platform. TPI is headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, operates factories in the U.S. and Mexico and has an engineering development center in Denmark with global service operations in the U.S., Mexico, and EU. Job Description Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Vice President, Environmental Health, Safety and Sustainability provides strategic direction and leadership for TPI’s environmental, health & safety programs. The incumbent is responsible for the continuous development and effective implementation of Safety Policies and Procedures. In addition, the incumbent leads the company’s sustainability program. He/she leads a team of safety professionals to drive and ensure a proactive safety culture across the organization as well as best in class sustainability practices. Key stakeholders include regional business leaders, customers as well as the Senior Leadership team at TPI Responsibilities & Accountabilities Drive a proactive safety culture across the organization Design, implement, and continuously improve enterprise-wide environmental, health & safety strategy and programs consistent with industry best practices, Define short and long term objectives to achieve company safety and sustainability goals and implement KPI’s, monthly reporting and business reviews to communicate progress Assess and drive implementation of optimal health & safety organizational structure, tools, training, programs, governance, and accountability models Leads efforts of safety organization through matrix leadership Provide technical expertise and thought leadership, create synergies and leverage knowledge, personnel, best practices, and resources across the organization Support the company’s US Worker’s Compensation Program effectively. This includes a focus on effective case management, return-to-work programs, and similar relative to work related illness and injuries. Ensure compliance with all environmental, health, and safety standards Monitor and facilitate the progress of environmental sustainability programs and governance systems, consistent with strategies, goals, measurements and reporting standards Lead the organization to behave with a sense of urgency, ensure that it is aligned and attracts the best talent Coordinate the executive level engagement between regions, customers and senior stakeholders Leverage synergies across various sites and participates/leads in sharing best practices Coach and mentor supply chain professionals across the organization Create and promote a culture of collaboration, team-work and fun while delivering to or exceeding expectations Who we are looking for: Minimum Education and Experience Bachelor's Engineering Degree in risk management, industrial Safety and Health, Safety engineering, Safety management, or closely related field 10-15 years’ leadership experience in regional or global manufacturing environment Knowledge and expertise in safety requirements in international locations (Americas and Europe) Proven ability to lead diverse safety teams to achieve organizational objectives Experience in the interpretation and enactment of Safety standards in OSHA and other global regulations Demonstrated ability to establish, implement, and manage best practice environmental, health & safety programs Familiarity with ISO 9001/14001/18001 implementation and program sustainability Ability to lead in a matrix environment Highly developed interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively, persuasively, and tactfully interact with employees at all levels of the organization. Highly effective presentation and training delivery skills Demonstrated ability to quickly establish credibility and lead by influence across all levels of the organization, from senior leadership to individual contributors This is a remote, U.S.-based role with willingness and ability to travel internationally to manufacturing sites. Build an effective team committed to organizational goals; foster collaboration among team members. Solution oriented, proactive approach and attitude in resolving issues without compromising quality Strong leadership, mentoring, organizational and communication skills Required Skills and Education - 15+ Years Management/Supervision Experience - Leadership experience in global manufacturing operations required Preferred Skills and Education -Experience in global organization -Experience leading teams through impact/influence -Experience in large scale industrial manufacturing

description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE . Support the annual Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment (EWRA) process by gathering information and tracking progress as a project manager. Collaborate with Business Unit Compliance teams to assist in documenting risk assessments and control inventories. Support the maintenance and updating of compliance control documentation aligned with regulatory requirements. Assist with rolling out of horizon scanning activities with key stakeholders. Help prepare management information (MI) reports and basic metrics for compliance risk insights. Provide project management support for the regulatory mapping roadmap, including tracking tasks, timelines, and stakeholder communications. Assist with compiling AI projects for the team and assist in translating into BRDs where possible. Perform other administrative and coordination tasks to support the Compliance Risk Management team as needed. Requirements: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a degree program in Finance, Business, Law, Risk Management, or related fields. Strong interest in compliance, risk management, and regulatory affairs. Good organizational skills and attention to detail. Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively. Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
